snippet.title: Kirk Mephisto - Official Reveal Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Kirk Mephisto, an action-adventure beat 'em up hack-and-slash game developed by Team Coreupt. Players will follow Kirk on his quest to stop the ongoing battle between birds and wormkind. Fighting alongside Kirk are his childhood friends Halice, the worm warrior princess, and Carper, the secret agent bee. Kirk Mephisto is coming soon to PC (Steam).
